Iyong mga deep driven concrete piles ang magsisilbing brake ng lahar at maiipon ito sa tabi na magsisilbing natural wall dahil tataas ito. Dugtungan lang ang mga concrete piles kapag maaabot na ng lahar ang dulo ng mga piles or matambakan ng lahar deposits individually dugtungan ang mga concrete driven piles.

God doesn't reward inaction, and simply making a statement isn't action.  If you're going to bring God into the world of humans to intervene, well, you better be living a life OF Christ.  Have a desert nearby to be in for 40 days?  40 BTW = an amount of time to complete a transformation, and on the other side of that transformation is living a life that Christ lived.

Ever hear a minister/pastor/etc.... tell the joke about the person who's drowning and ignores the boats God sent to save him?  We don't get to ignore what's happening.

comments.text:
Areas with tall buildings will of course sink + the usage on ground water from below and the pressure from the building's weight from above will make the surrounding terrain drop lower. 

China learned that the hard way and now design around waterscapes to avoid the depletion of the aquifers keeping the top from dropping lower.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: That China comparison is a good one - cities like Beijing and Shanghai dealt with serious subsidence from groundwater over-extraction for decades before adjusting policy, and it's exactly the kind of lesson worth applying elsewhere before the damage becomes irreversible.
